users.usb-storage-description: Access all connected USB drives, including drives connected in the future
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.ai-agents-descrip: With the new MCP server in umbrelOS, connect any AI agent to install apps, organize files, or troubleshoot issues for you. Each gets its own token and only the access you allow.
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.ai-agents-heading: Let AI agents manage your Umbrel
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.app-settings-desc: Point any app at folders on external or network drives and choose exactly what it can access. You can even move entire apps to external drives.
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.cloud-description: Download your files from Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud, and more in one go, or keep them backing up to your Umbrel continuously.
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.gpu-description: umbrelOS now automatically detects NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs, including Thunderbolt eGPUs, and lets apps like Ollama and Jellyfin use them.
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.mac-app-descripti: Umbrel for Mac finds your Umbrel automatically and adds it as a drive in your Finder. Drag files in at home, and stay connected over Tailscale when you're away.
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.machines-descript: Run Windows, Ubuntu, Debian, Android, and more, right inside your Umbrel. Machines lets you install them in one click and hands you the full desktop in your browser.
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.machines-heading: A whole computer, in a browser tab
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.multi-user-descri: Everyone gets their own account, home screen, and private home folder. Share only the apps and folders you choose.
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.photos-descriptio: Photos and videos on your Umbrel show up in the new Photos app automatically. And with the new Umbrel for iPhone app, your entire camera roll backs up to your Umbrel on its own.
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.redesign-descript: The biggest update to umbrelOS yet, and everything a home cloud was always meant to be.
whats-new-umbrelos-2-0.storage-manager-d: On any device with multiple internal SSD or HDD slots, combine your drives into one space or choose FailSafe (RAID) for peace of mind if a drive fails. NAS devices with both HDD and SSD slots can also enable SSD acceleration.

wifi-dangerous-change-confirmation-descr: Changing the Wi-Fi network may disconnect you from your Umbrel. To reconnect, ensure that both your Umbrel and the device you're accessing it from are on the same network.
wifi-dangerous-change-confirmation-title: Are you sure you want to change Wi-Fi network?
wifi-dangerous-disable-confirmation-desc: Disabling Wi-Fi may disconnect you from your Umbrel. To reconnect, plug in an Ethernet cable to your Umbrel and ensure that both your Umbrel and the device you're accessing it from are on the same network.
wifi-dangerous-disable-confirmation-titl: Are you sure you want to disable Wi-Fi?
wifi-description: Connect your device to a Wi-Fi network
wifi-description-long: Your device stays connected to your chosen Wi-Fi, even if the Ethernet cable is removed, and automatically reconnects to Wi-Fi on startup.
wifi-unsupported-device-description: Wi-Fi is not supported on this device. This may be due to a missing or incompatible wireless adapter.
